_doc: Repo-wide review provider availability, read by review_gate.py in every checkout. Disabled providers are skipped even with explicit --reviewer; disabled Codex also suppresses native requests. An entry can carry reason and retry_after UTC expiry for temporary outages, a reason string, or true. Remove durable entries only after access is restored. See docs/operations/github-workflow-conventions.md#review-provider-availability.

claude.reason: Organization access disabled; operator must confirm restoration before re-enabling.
